_comment: Weeks of the frozen flashcard curriculum that are not shown in the web app or on the static site until they have been reviewed. The words stay in flashcard_sets.json and the week numbers do not change, so nothing shifts when a week is released: delete its entry here and rebuild the site. Read by web/flashcards.py (held_weeks, load_sets).

weeks.reason: Ceremonial vocabulary (sacred bundles, dances, doctoring). Whether it belongs in a public flashcard deck is for the Pawnee Nation to decide; it has not been asked yet. See reports/audit_data_construction_2026-10-01.md, item B6.
